en.title: Happy Number
en.description:
Given a positive integer n, repeatedly replace it with the sum of the squares of its digits. If the process reaches 1, output the happy-number marker; if it enters a cycle that does not contain 1, output the non-happy-number marker.

The input protocol was prepared by this site; the count and distance ranges of Road Trip are explicit supplements by this site and do not represent limits of the original problem.
en.output: Output 1 for a happy number, otherwise output 0.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
